by_year.2021: FAST (24/7 instant transfers) live from 8 Jan 2021: per-transfer limit TRY 50, TRY 1,000 from 29 Jan, TRY 2,000 from 4 Aug 2021 (about USD 114-227 at the 2021 mean rate). From 30 Apr 2021 payment and e-money institutions may not intermediate transfers to crypto platforms (CBRT regulation, Official Gazette 16 Apr 2021), so lira legs go through bank accounts. EFT 08:30-17:30 on weekdays.
by_year.2022: FAST limit TRY 5,000 from 21 Feb 2022 (about USD 301 at the 2022 mean rate); later steps up to TRY 50,000 before Apr 2024 are unverified. EFT hours unchanged.
by_year.2023: FAST limit between TRY 5,000 and TRY 50,000 (steps unverified); payment and e-money institutions admitted to FAST in 2023. EFT hours unchanged.
by_year.2024: FAST limit TRY 50,000, TRY 100,000 from 4 Apr 2024 (about USD 1521-3041). Redesigned CBRT payment systems from 23 Feb 2024, hours unchanged.
by_year.2025: FAST limit TRY 100,000 (about USD 2528). EFT hours unchanged.
by_year.2026: FAST limit TRY 100,000 (about USD 2203) until 25 Aug 2026, TRY 300,000 from 26 Aug 2026; Binance lira books restricted from 13 Nov 2025. EFT hours unchanged.

institutions.eft_hours: Weekdays except public holidays 08:30-17:30, 13:00 on half days (CBRT; PFMI disclosure 29 Dec 2021 section 2.9; unchanged through 2026 per tables/rob_xc_inst_try.json).

holiday_check.source: Law No. 2429 on National and General Holidays (Ulusal Bayram ve Genel Tatiller Hakkinda Kanun, 17 Mar 1981, as amended: 1 Jan, 23 Apr, 1 May, 19 May, 15 Jul, 30 Aug, 29 Oct; half day on 28 Oct and on the eves of the religious holidays) and the Presidency of Religious Affairs (Diyanet Isleri Baskanligi) calendar for Ramazan Bayrami (2021-05-13..15, 2022-05-02..04, 2023-04-21..23) and Kurban Bayrami (2021-07-20..23, 2022-07-09..12, 2023-06-28..07-01); weekday dates only. Cross-checked against the CBRT indicative-rate archive (no file on holidays and half days).
